name: White Lies & Sweet Nothings
source:
It all started with a little white lie…

Congratulations. You’ve landed your dream job. So you had to tell a few white lies to get your foot in the door, big deal! Now all you’ve got to do is find someone to play your husband. In front of the entire company. By tomorrow. Well, at least there’s been no shortage of men this morning!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.ent.g.white.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
这一切都始于一个善意的谎言……

恭喜。你已经找到了梦想的工作。所以你必须说一些善意的谎言才能踏入大门，这有什么大不了的！现在你所要做的就是找一个人来扮演你的丈夫。当着全公司的面。明天之前。好吧，至少今天早上不缺男人！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.ent.g.white.en]谷歌游戏[/url]]
